draft_en.body:
Hi Miloš,

You asked on Alibaba for media converters and did not get a proper answer from us - apologies, here it is.

Neutral-brand industrial converters, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, from small lots: Gigabit, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (or fixed SC single-mode 20 km) - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); Gigabit PoE+ version - STI-111GP - $27.8. Desktop versions on request.

One question: what quantity and fibre type - single-mode distance, or SFP-slot so the customer picks the optic - does your end customer need?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
